call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Korean online recruitment poster, one independent flat square image, 1:1.
Primary request: Fictional neighborhood repair workshop invitation. Make exactly one finished flat poster. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Design idea: An informed invitation to inspect an everyday item and understand limits before applying. The supplied conditions organize the poster, and the object is visibly awaiting inspection. Deadline and full application URL are immediately findable.

Concrete composition and type: Use a clear editorial layout on a pale cool off-white background, deep ink-blue Korean sans-serif text with a warm rust-orange application area. A large bold single-line title at the top with its supplied subtitle close beneath. Directly below, establish a relationship between the bringing/exclusion copy and a small, precisely rendered tabletop inspection still life placed on the right: one unbranded natural-canvas tote bag lying flat, with a short section of loose stitching where one fabric handle meets the bag body, not a completed repair. A simple magnifying lens rests near that seam, and a needle threaded with a short thread and a small thread spool sit on the table as relevant supplied repair tools. Only one brought everyday object. No people or hands. Bag fabric, handle attachments, loose threads, lens contact, needle, spool and table must be structurally credible, with restrained soft overhead daylight and consistent short contact shadows; no floating parts, no glow or glass spectacle. The image ends cleanly before the text and never interrupts strokes.

Give the long inspection-limit sentence strong readable emphasis below the object-and-bringing relationship, then connect the supplied-tools/component-cost sentence, photography-consent sentence and participation-fee sentence as a compact, well-spaced editorial group. Keep all conditions readable at ordinary screen size. Group the supplied date/time, place and eligibility together as practical appointment details. Let the application sentence occupy an unmistakable full-width rust-orange lower band with high-contrast large dark text, preserving the full URL visibly and continuously; it may wrap between the Korean deadline segment and the URL, never inside the URL. Put the inquiry sentence directly below. Typography should have consistent Korean word spacing, unbroken syllable strokes, deliberate baselines, generous line spacing and precise alignment. Use meaningful gaps and relative weights, no new headings, no icons, no check marks, no numbering, no badges or decorative marks. Use the longest condition to determine sufficient text area; wrap only at word boundaries and never shrink away the conditions. Keep the central inspection image modest enough to protect all fourteen text items.

Printable text: Render each of the following fourteen exact supplied items ONCE. These are the only printable words; do not print the labels or quote marks in this prompt. Preserve every spelling, space, punctuation mark, number and symbol. You may regroup these items by meaning and wrap at word boundaries without changing any wording. In particular preserve the en dash in 2시–5시, the middle dots, the comma in 5,000원, and the full address haram-mend.example/join.

이웃 수리 작업실 참여자 모집

Constraints: Single square flat poster, full bleed artwork without mockup perspective, no panel or contact sheet. All text intact, no duplication or omission. No guaranteed repair result, no electric/battery product or hazardous brought item, no invented event facts or promises. No extra copy, logos, labels, marks, watermarks or texture that weakens letter readability. Clean controlled type and object rendering appropriate for a practical community invitation.
